C1191.title: IngressNightmare Exposes Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Ingress NGINX
C1191.summary: On March 24, 2025, Wiz and the Kubernetes project disclosed the IngressNightmare vulnerability set. CVE-2025-1974 could enable unauthenticated remote code execution through an exposed Ingress NGINX admission controller. Successful exploitation could expose Secrets across all namespaces and lead to cluster takeover. The project advised immediate upgrades or restricting access to the admission-controller port.
